offering_description.value: Provides healthcare staffing to schools and healthcare facilities, including nurses and allied health professionals. Delivers engineering design and project services to utilities and industrial companies. Provides IT consulting, technical staffing, and life sciences services through contracted specialists and project teams.

primary_products.value: engineered process equipment for distillation, evaporation and dehydration

primary_services.value: healthcare staffing; engineering design and project delivery; IT consulting and staffing; life sciences validation and compliance services

customer_segment.value: B2B: healthcare facilities, private schools, utilities, industrial manufacturers, aerospace companies and life sciences companies; B2G: public school districts and other public institutions

end_markets.value: education; healthcare; power and utilities; aerospace and industrial manufacturing; life sciences

revenue_model.value: service fees: hourly assignments for clinical, engineering and technology professionals; project or contract: engineering design, process systems, technology implementation and life sciences validation projects

value_chain_position.value: service provider: recruits clinical and technical professionals and deploys them to schools, healthcare facilities and corporate clients

geography_served.value: global: primarily the United States, with operations in Canada and engineering projects in other countries

specialization.value: related lines: healthcare staffing, engineering and process systems, IT consulting and life sciences services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with school districts, healthcare facilities, utilities and corporate clients

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: clinical staffing and engineering work are subject to state professional licensing and credentialing rules

notes: The current segment order and the share of process equipment sold separately from engineering projects are uncertain.
